Corollary
[Strong maximum principle under Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0397 ↗ cor:chow-iii-ricci-flow-supersolution-mean-value 1. ch26:26.46\group Ricci Flow Heat Balls

If $R\ge 0$ and a heat supersolution (w) attains its space-time minimum at $(x_0,t_0)$, then $w(x,t)=w(x_0,t_0)$ for all $t\le t_0$.
